items.stem: What is the main purpose of a satellite's attitude control subsystem?

options.text: To point the satellite and its payload correctly
options.rationale: Correct: attitude control orients the spacecraft and payload.

Launch to orbit is the launch vehicle's role.

items.stem: Why might a service use a constellation of satellites rather than a single one?

options.text: To provide continuous or global coverage that one satellite cannot
options.rationale: Correct: multiple satellites give persistent and wider coverage.

options.text: Because a single satellite is always illegal
options.rationale: Single satellites are widely used; this is not a legal issue.

options.text: Because constellations need no ground stations
options.rationale: Constellations still rely on ground segments.

options.text: Because one satellite cannot carry any payload
